arxiv-1908-11748.title: Unequal rapidity correlators in the dilute limit of JIMWLK
arxiv-1908-11748.description: Abstract We study unequal rapidity correlators in the stochastic Langevin picture of Jalilian-Marian–Iancu–McLerran–Weigert–Leonidov–Kovner (JIMWLK) evolution in the Color Glass Condensate effective field theory. By separately evolving the Wilson lines in the direct and complex conjugate amplitudes, we use the formalism to study two-particle production at large rapidity separations.

arxiv-2208-00018.title: Low Spin-Axis Variations of Circumbinary Planets 2015 Low Spin-Axis Variations of Circumbinary Planets – 15
arxiv-2208-00018.creator: Renyi Chen, Gongjie Li, Molei Tao
arxiv-2208-00018.description: Abstract Having a massive moon has been considered as a primary mechanism for stabilized planetary obliquity, an example of which being our Earth. This is, however, not always consistent with the exoplanetary cases. This article details the discovery of an alternative mechanism, namely that planets orbiting around binary stars tend to have low spin-axis variations.

arxiv-2306-04026.title: Value Functions as Control Barrier Functions: Verification of Safe Policies using Control Theory
arxiv-2306-04026.creator: Daniel C.H. Tan, Fernando Acero, Robert McCarthy, Dimitrios Kanoulas, Zhibin Li
arxiv-2306-04026.description: Abstract Guaranteeing safe behaviour of reinforcement learning (RL) policies poses significant challenges for safety-critical applications, despite RL’s generality and scalability. To address this, we propose a new approach to apply verification methods from control theory to learned value functions. By analyzing task structures for safety preservation, we formalize original theorems that establish links between value functions and control barrier functions.

arxiv-2402-14671.title: Linear isometries of Hol ( 𝔻 ) \mathop{\rm Hol}\nolimits(\mathbb{D})
arxiv-2402-14671.creator: I. Chalendar, L. Oger, J. R. Partington
arxiv-2402-14671.description: Abstract . A complete characterisation is given of all the linear isometries of the Fréchet space of all holomorphic functions on the unit disc, when it is given one of the two standard metrics: these turn out to be weighted composition operators of a particular form. Operators similar to an isometry are also classified.

arxiv-2407-08976.title: Computational-Statistical Trade-off in Kernel Two-Sample Testing with Random Fourier Features
arxiv-2407-08976.creator: Ikjun Choi, Ilmun Kim
arxiv-2407-08976.description: Abstract Recent years have seen a surge in methods for two-sample testing, among which the Maximum Mean Discrepancy (MMD) test has emerged as an effective tool for handling complex and high-dimensional data. Despite its success and widespread adoption, the primary limitation of the MMD test has been its quadratic-time complexity, which poses challenges for large-scale analysis.

arxiv-2412-11789.title: Triviality, Rotational Symmetry, and Classification of Complete Expanding Gradient Yamabe Solitons Thanks: The author is partially supported by the Grant-in-Aid for Scientific Research (C), No.23K03107, Japan Society for the Promotion of Science.
arxiv-2412-11789.creator: Shun Maeta
arxiv-2412-11789.description: Abstract . In this paper, we rigorously analyze the scalar curvature of complete expanding gradient Yamabe solitons. We show that if the scalar curvature is less than the soliton constant by an arbitrarily small positive amount, then the soliton is trivial.

arxiv-2503-08731.title: FairDeFace: Evaluating the Fairness and Adversarial Robustness of Face Obfuscation Methods
arxiv-2503-08731.creator: Seyyed Mohammad Sadegh Moosavi Khorzooghi 2 , Poojitha Thota 2 , Mohit Singhal 3 , Abolfazl Asudeh 4 Gautam Das 2 , Shirin Nilizadeh 2

The lack of a common platform and benchmark datasets for evaluating face obfuscation methods has been a challenge, with every method being tested using arbitrary experiments, datasets, and metrics.

arxiv-2503-15078.title: Fast But Accurate: A Real-Time Hyperelastic Simulator with Robust Frictional Contact
arxiv-2503-15078.creator: Ziqiu Zeng, Siyuan Luo, Fan Shi, Zhongkai Zhang
arxiv-2503-15078.description: Abstract . We present a GPU-friendly framework for real-time implicit simulation of elastic material in the presence of frictional contacts. The integration of hyperelasticity, non-interpenetration contact, and friction in real-time simulations presents formidable nonlinear and non-smooth problems, which are highly challenging to solve. By incorporating nonlinear complementarity conditions within the local-global framework, we achieve rapid convergence in addressing these challenges.

arxiv-2506-22464.title: Golden Ratio Assisted Localization for Wireless Sensor Network
arxiv-2506-22464.creator: 1 st Hitesh Mohapatra
arxiv-2506-22464.description: Abstract This paper presents a novel localization algorithm for wireless sensor networks (WSNs) called Golden Ratio Localization (GRL) , which leverages the mathematical properties of the golden ratio ( ϕ ≈ 1.618 \phi\approx 1.618 ) to optimize both node placement and communication range.

arxiv-2507-23707.title: Cellular, Cell-less, and Everything in Between: A Unified Framework for Utility Region Analysis in Wireless Networks
arxiv-2507-23707.creator: R. L. G. Cavalcante, T. Piotrowski, S. Stanczak, † {\dagger} Fraunhofer Heirinch Hertz Institute, Germany Nicolaus Copernicus University, Poland ♢ {\diamondsuit} Technical University of Berlin, Germany
arxiv-2507-23707.description: Abstract We introduce a unified framework for analyzing utility regions of wireless networks, with a focus on the signal-to-interference-noise-ratio (SINR) and achievable rate regions. The framework provides valuable insights into interference patterns of modern network architectures, such as cell-less and extremely large MIMO networks, and it generalizes existing characterizations of the weak Pareto boundary.

arxiv-2508-15460.title: Coupled Vlasov and non-Newtonian fluid dynamics: existence and large-time behavior
arxiv-2508-15460.creator: Young-Pil Choi, Jinwook Jung, Aneta Wróblewska-Kamińska
arxiv-2508-15460.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Young-Pil Choi, Jinwook Jung, Aneta Wróblewska-Kamińska. We study a coupled kinetic-non-Newtonian fluid system on the periodic domain 𝕋 3 \mathbb{T}^{3} , where particles evolve by a Vlasov equation and interact with an incompressible power-law fluid through a drag force. We prove the global existence of weak solutions for all p > 8 5 p>\frac{8}{5} , where p > 1 p>1 denotes the power-law exponent of the fluid’s stress-strain relation.

arxiv-2511-18407.title: On Thermodynamics of Charged Black Holes via Extended Space-time Derivatives
arxiv-2511-18407.creator: Adil Belhaj, Maryem Jemri, ESMaR, Faculty of Science, Mohammed V University in Rabat, Rabat, Morocco
arxiv-2511-18407.description: Abstract Inspired by non-commutative geometry in string theory, we propose extended derivatives in black hole physics by incorporating a real antisymmetric tensor of rank 2 carrying similarities of certain stringy fields. Using gauge theory formulation of gravity via de Sitter group theory, we first find the associated black hole solutions by solving the Einstein field equations.

pmc-10608964.title: Simply Versatile: The Use of Peribacillus simplex in Sustainable Agriculture
pmc-10608964.creator: Julia Manetsberger, Natacha Caballero Gómez, Carlos Soria-Rodríguez, Nabil Benomar, Hikmate Abriouel
pmc-10608964.description: Peribacillus simplex is a Gram-positive, spore-forming bacterium derived from a vast range of different origins. Notably, it is part of the plant-growth-promoting rhizobacterial community of many crops. Although members of the Bacillaceae family have been widely used in agriculture, P. simplex has, so far, remained in the shadow of its more famous relatives, e.g., Bacillus subtilis or Bacillus thuringiensis.

pmc-10644007.title: The worthy role of hepatic arterial infusion chemotherapy in combination with anti-programmed cell death protein 1 monoclonal antibody immunotherapy in advanced hepatocellular carcinoma
pmc-10644007.creator: Yixin Ding, Shasha Wang, Zhenkang Qiu, Chunyang Zhu, Yan Wang, Shufen Zhao, Wensheng Qiu, Kongjia Wang, Jing Lv, Weiwei Qi
pmc-10644007.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Systemic therapy remains the primary therapeutic approach for advanced hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC). Nonetheless, its efficacy in achieving control of intrahepatic lesions is constrained. Hepatic arterial infusion chemotherapy (HAIC) is a therapeutic approach that combines localized treatment with systemic antitumor effects, which aim is to effectively manage the progression of cancerous lesions within the liver, particularly in patients with portal vein tumor thrombosis (PVTT).

pmc-10653977.title: Left Juxtaposition of the Right Atrial Appendage: Pitfalls in Diagnosis
pmc-10653977.creator: Kanya Singhapakdi, Wesam Sourour, Thomas R. Kimball
pmc-10653977.description: Several congenital anomalies of the right atrial appendage (RAA) have been described including aneurysm, herniation (in association with a pericardial defect), and left juxtaposition. The left juxtaposition of the RAA (LJRAA), first described by Birmingham in 1893 and subsequently introduced by Dixon in 1954, is usually associated with complex cardiac malformations such as obstruction of the left ventricular outflow tract.

pmc-10735875.title: ALLEVIATING WORRIES OF DEMENTIA AMONG OLDER ADULTS WHO ATTEND AN AGING BRAIN SEMINAR
pmc-10735875.creator: Grace Simonson, Susan Wehry
pmc-10735875.description: Dementia worry is prevalent among older adults, and these concerns are often not addressed. Research demonstrates the public lacks accurate knowledge of dementia, which contributes to its negative perception. We hypothesized participation in an aging brain seminar would significantly alleviate dementia worry in older adults.

pmc-12391488.title: Mechanism and function of GPR3 regulated by a negative allosteric modulator
pmc-12391488.creator: Geng Chen, Jana Bláhová, Nico Staffen, Harald Hübner, Nadja Nunhöfer, Chen Qiu, Peter Gmeiner, Dorothee Weikert, Yang Du, Jun Xu
pmc-12391488.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Allosteric modulators have gained substantial interest in current GPCR drug discovery. Here, we present a mechanism of allosteric modulation involving the dimerization of GPR3, a promising drug target for metabolic diseases and central nervous system disorders. We show that GPR3 forms constitutive homodimers in live cells and reveal that the inhibitor AF64394 functions as a negative allosteric modulator (NAM) specifically targeting dimeric GPR3. Using cryogenic electron microscopy (cryo-EM), we determine the structures of the AF64394-bound GPR3 dimer and its dimer-Gs signaling complex.

pmc-13582326.title: Psychological dynamics and adaptive processes of negative online social interactions among university students: a qualitative study in higher education digital environments
pmc-13582326.creator: Wei Zheng, Haoran Chen, Jiayuan Gu, Xinwen Huan
pmc-13582326.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). ObjectiveAs digital platforms increasingly shape university students’ learning, social interactions, and identity construction, negative online social interactions have become important experiences in connected digital environments. Existing research has mainly examined specific negative online behaviors, such as cyberbullying and online exclusion, and their psychological consequences, while paying less attention to how students interpret and adapt to negative interactions embedded in everyday digital life.

pmc-13592271.title: Personalized digital pipeline for basal cell carcinoma delineation using hyperspectral imaging
pmc-13592271.creator: Paulina Ibek, Alexander Degener, Magne Stridh, Marcus Tegnér, Patrik Edén, Victor Olariu, Malin Malmsjö, Aboma Merdasa
pmc-13592271.description: Basal cell carcinoma (BCC) is the most common form of skin cancer with the current diagnostic procedures relying on surgical excisions and histopathological analyses. Incomplete removal of the tumor necessitates additional surgery, which is both costly and time-consuming. To address this, non-invasive diagnostic techniques capable of determining the dimensions of skin cancer preoperatively are urgently needed.
